The two-step save feels right—I like reviewing the automatically filled details before adding the bookmark.

The saved card has the important text, but I’d also expect the site’s small icon to be collected and shown so I can scan the list more easily. A preview image can be saved with the bookmark too, though it doesn’t need to dominate the list.

A few saving details still seem missing:

- I need a way to mark the bookmark as “read later” while saving it.
- When I type tags, existing tags should be suggested so I don’t accidentally create near-duplicates.
- If I save the same address again, it should recognize the existing bookmark and let me edit that one rather than create a duplicate.

With those corrections, this capture flow would match what I want.
